Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. ClearCrest is trying to lock a compact SOC 2 + DPA walkthrough next week that won't disrupt our engineering day — ideally an evening slot (US ET) so our European ops team can join without blocking too many people.

High level ask: 45–60 min walkthrough focused on architecture + data flows, followed by a separate evidence handoff window for S3/SFTP transfer. We also want a short Q&A on pen-test readiness.

Can you propose 2–3 evening windows (6–9pm ET) and confirm who from Redwood will cover the technical deep-dive and who will own the evidence transfer conversation?

I attached a preliminary evidence index to speed triage.

Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 20:05:00 -05:00

James — thanks for the index, that helps a lot. We can absolutely do an evening compact session plus a separate evidence handoff. Proposed options (all ET):

- Tue 7 Dec, 6:30–7:15pm — short-form walkthrough (45m) + 15m buffer
- Wed 8 Dec, 7:30–8:15pm — short-form walkthrough (45m) + buffer
- Thu 9 Dec, 8:00–9:00pm — full 60m slot if you want the pen Q&A in-band

Coverage plan: I (Chloe) will lead the architecture/data-flow walkthrough and the standard SOC 2 control mapping. Ben Carter (cc'd) will handle pen-test posture and remote evidence ingestion options (SFTP vs. secure upload). Irene will join for any DPA/contract questions and to confirm evidence retention controls.

Two quick asks before we lock:
1) Can you confirm the list of ClearCrest attendees (names + roles) we should expect for the call?
2) For the evidence handoff — do you prefer a scheduled SFTP session, a one-off secure upload link, or a short-lived console transfer? We can support all three but will prep the right playbook depending on your choice.

If any of those slots work I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a secure upload link.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Security Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
signature: Chloe Martin | Security Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference | chloe_martin@redwood.ai

Chloe — thanks, I can cover the pen posture and evidence pipeline. Quick notes for the plan:

- Recommend the Tue 7 Dec 6:30pm slot for a tight 45m walkthrough. Keeps the pen Q&A focused and reduces follow-ups.
- For evidence, our standard safe path is:
  1) Pre-stage index spreadsheet (James' attachment)
  2) We provide a pre-provisioned SFTP account for bulk artifact transfer (48-hour retention window) OR a one-time secure upload link that lands in a locked bucket with HSM-backed KMS.
  3) If either party prefers, we can arrange a brief post-call SFTP session (30 min) for live handoff and verification.

Operational asks for ClearCrest before the call:
- Confirm s3/bucket naming convention or if you prefer managed SFTP user.
- Confirm any IP allowlist for the transfer window (we can provide IPs).
- If you want the pen Q&A in-band (adds ~15–20m), we should widen the slot to 60m.

Irene — when we finalize the slot I can draft the short evidence transfer instructions and a one-click secure link.

Ben Carter
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
